Our Story · Outer Sunset Since the Early 1990s

A Neighborhood Institution on Noriega Street.

For over three decades, Cafe Bakery & Restaurant (咖啡小館 港式西餐) has anchored the Outer Sunset’s Cantonese dining corridor. While our historic bakery counter has retired into neighborhood legend, our kitchen continues to Dish out the unmistakable comfort of old-school Hong Kong Western cuisine.

Walk past the stone facade and lace curtains into a bustling dining room where Cantonese grandpas, multi-generational families, and local regulars gather over steaming bowls of Russian borscht, crispy garlic pork chops, and oversized plates of sweet-savory Chinese spaghetti—served swiftly by our team of Cantonese-, Mandarin-, and English-speaking aunties.

Neighborhood Note on the Historic Bakery:

While our name honors our original 1990s bakery heritage, the pastry counter has permanently retired so our kitchen can focus 100% on full-course Hong Kong-style Western lunches and dinners.
